steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Got a call for you, Chief.
Nightingale passes the receiver to you. It's a call from Serpent Eye, a renowned private military company regularly hired by Eastside's upper class and highly reputed within the industry.

steps.speaker: Man's Voice
steps.content: My name is Alyosha. I'm in charge of Serpent Eye.
A man's voice comes through the phone. It sounds old, low, and slightly accented.
The same man phoned MBCC's office a few minutes ago, refused to reveal any information to anyone, not even to Nightingale, and demanded to speak with you—the Chief of MBCC—directly.
Hello, this is the Chief of MBCC. May I know your purpose of calling?

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: I need to requisition someone.
Requisition a Sinner?
For what purpose?

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Deputy Speaker Reagan is going on a tour soon. He's appointed Cinnabar as his bodyguard.
With all due respect, requisitioning a Sinner to protect an official is not exactly a sensible request. In terms of both ability and emotion, Sinners are highly unstable...

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Cinnabar is different!

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: ...Cinnabar is an elite in the industry. It's Mr. Reagan's very idea to requisition her.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: The requisition document will reach you soon.
A disconnect tone from the receiver. Alyosha has hung up.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I'm ready. You may interrogate me whenever you want.

Cinnabar initiates the conversation in the interrogation room. With no display of aggression, she's simply sitting there, straight-backed and with a sincere look on her face, looking like a friend who's ready to listen to your rant.

Except that she's not your friend. This subject named Cinnabar has had strict military training and is pretty famous among the mercenary and security industries. Her mild exterior could be nothing more than a disguise.

options: I need to learn about your past.

choices.text: I need to learn about your past.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Are you referring to the crimes I've committed?
Not entirely. I'd like you to tell me more about yourself.
Cinnabar snickers, probably unconvinced by your pretext.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Sure. Where should we start?
Cinnabar's friendly attitude makes you feel at ease. You pick up the first document on the desk.

From the 100% assignment completion during her early mercenary days, to the later zero on-duty casualty rate as a security consultant for Eastside's City Council, Cinnabar's entire career has been impeccably successful. Her résumé is too perfect to pique anyone's interest in discussing it.
You flip through the pages for a few minutes and finally spot an intriguing talking point.
On February 14th, N.F. 106, you single-handedly rescued Councilor Pend's daughter from a dozen of kidnappers?
Cinnabar considers it briefly.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Do you mean Miss Hilda?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Indeed, I took part in her rescue, but I didn't do it all by myself. My teammates at Serpent Eye supported me with crucial intelligence.
You take another glance at the document. Here comes the best part of the case.
The incident received long-lasting attention from Eastside's media. I assume you also got your fifteen minutes of fame through all this?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: For people in my line of work, it's not considered a bad thing to be known for your work performance.
But the report says you're well-known mainly because... Miss Pend confessed her love for you on TV?
Cinnabar flushes instantly.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I... Ugh, Miss Hilda probably mistook me for a man. I clarified that with her afterward...
Is it? Earlier, when you were taken in by MBCC, she even wrote us a protest letter demanding your immediate release.
Besides, it seems that among those in high places in Eastside, quite a few young ladies have a thing for you.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: All I can say is that... I'm grateful for their kindness. But... regretfully, I don't hold affections of this sort for my clients. I find that irresponsible and unprofessional.
Cinnabar's reaction is amusing. But enough of awkward talks. Time is running out, and you still need to pry more information out of her.

options: Ask about the incident two years ago

choices.text: Ask about the incident two years ago

steps.content: It seems that up until two years ago, you'd been much appreciated by Eastside's powerful and rich.
As the new subject is brought up, Cinnabar, who has been a little flustered just now, quickly collects herself.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I'm truly grateful to my clients who trusted me fully, but protecting them was only my duty, regardless of their appreciation for me.
Cinnabar's response is intriguing. Whatever happened two years ago should be no simple matter.

The document describes a riot that erupted on Pasture Block in Syndicate two years ago. Neither the cause nor the outcome of the riot is clearly elaborated, and the only detailed part of the record suggests that "a security consultant was absent without leave when escorting the delegation from Eastside, and was subsequently wanted for turning into a Sinner."
Reading the document you've passed to her, Cinnabar gives a wry smile.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Is that how they interpreted the situation...
You were hired by the City Council, but went AWOL at the critical moment. That was out of character for you. What was your defense?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I didn't have any. It happened as recorded in the report. I deserted my unit alone and left the delegation to my teammates at Serpent Eye.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: After that, I became a Sinner... I won't deny having committed those crimes—but I also do not regret committing them.
Dismissed from all job duties and wanted by the authorities for one single incidence of AWOL, the bigwigs of Eastside had no mercy on you at all, did they?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: That's not true. I indeed betrayed the trust of my clients, leaving them to my teammates at Serpent Eye.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: During my desertion, I was infected with the Mania. But even so, I tried to return to the City Council's station, causing a panic... That really shouldn't have been the behavior of a professional.
Cinnabar's response does not offer any explanations for her initial motive.
Could you tell me the reason why you deserted the unit?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: ...It was a gang war. Gang members intruded on a civilian block.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I'd seen their brutal way. The low-ranking gangsters would not spare a target just because it was a woman or child...

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I couldn't just leave the civilians like that.
Cinnabar pauses, then continues.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Their target wasn't the delegation, and a small gang of thugs wouldn't have posed a real threat anyway. That was why I judged that it was safe to leave the delegation to my colleagues.
Cinnabar gives a gratified smile.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I saved quite a few people.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: It hadn't been without incident, but what happened didn't change the outcome. What mattered the most was that they all survived.
In exchange, you became a Sinner, lost your job, and were wanted by the City Council...

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Given another chance, I would still make the same choice.
Cinnabar's description does not contradict the facts you know. It also explains why the City Council's document conceals what happened before the misfeasance.
Looking back, the City Council most likely wanted to make an example of her. Now that the controversy has died down, it makes sense to want to put Cinnabar back to work.

options: You still have a chance to go back.

choices.text: You still have a chance to go back.

steps.content: Your ability is undeniable. They shouldn't have let you go like that.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Some things cannot be undone.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Even if the City Council is willing to turn a blind eye to my past, my teammates... my colleagues at Serpent Eye will never forgive me.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Serpent Eye suffered a huge loss for my action. Whether I did it to protect the civilians or for whatever other reason, betrayal is betrayal.
Cinnabar casts her gaze aside. Her eyes are dark.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: One cannot handle this job alone. Yet, I let down my comrades who trusted me with their lives...
She is wrong. Serpent Eye has not turned its back on her.
Earlier today, I received a call from a man named Alyosha.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Alyosha?!
Cinnabar's eyes light up, even her body is beginning to lean forward.
He claimed to work for Serpent Eye. Do you know him?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: He is one of the founders of Serpent Eye, as well as the captain. How... is he doing? Is everything alright at Serpent Eye?
You haven't been in touch for long?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: No...
Serpent Eye is still the security company to serve the City Council and Eastside's bigwigs. Alyosha sounded well too.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I see...
He's made a pretty unreasonable request, concerning you.
Cinnabar blinks, confused.
He wants me to let you out, so you can take care of a mission.

Serpent Eye wants to requisition you to protect the current Deputy Speaker of the City Council.
The Deputy Speaker plans to give speeches in Eastside soon. Just recently, he's received a death threat.
Despite having left her position for years, as an elite in the industry, Cinnabar's instinct kicks in quickly.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Does the intelligence have any clues yet?
No. The guy sends threatening letters to Reagan's personal terminal every day, using virtual IPs. The intelligence hasn't been able to trace any useful information.
After thinking for a moment, Cinnabar promptly gives her professional advice.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: The person sending the threats is good with technology, shortwave communication equipment and an EMP device will be necessary. Hmm... We must also beware of remote bombs...
Looks like you're all ready.
Cinnabar lifts her head and looks dazed for a moment.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: ...I'm a Sinner. I work for you, I shouldn't go outside for personal matters.

Since the assassination of a councilor by a Maniac eight years ago, MBCC has been obliged to provide security support for any events involving officials. Of course, only when the organizer requires it. It won't be a personal matter if we send you.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Serpent Eye is capable of protecting Reagan. I shouldn't be needed.
Cinnabar seems hesitant, perhaps not yet prepared to meet her old teammates.
My initial response to Alyosha was this: "Are you sure she can pull off such an important mission? Don't forget she's a Sinner who requires constant supervision."
But Alyosha said, "Cinnabar is different from the other Sinners!"
And these résumés on the desk—who do you think sent them?
Give your colleagues the trust they deserve. They very likely fought for this mission, for you.
Maybe they've long forgiven you. It's just that you haven't forgiven yourself.
After a brief moment of silence, Cinnabar's eyes are filled with determination.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: If this is truly what Alyosha and the others wish for... then I shouldn't let them down again.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I accept this mission.
Then it's all set. By the way, out of MBCC's supervisory duty, I must accompany you throughout. After all...

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I understand.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Rest assured, I will obey the rules.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Rest assured, I will remain in your sight.
